actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production character asset for a gothic fantasy animated short. Input image 1 is the AUTHOR-APPROVED identity, exact garment color and rendering reference. Draw the SAME orange/copper-haired Claude girl, warm amber eyes, same delicately shaped face, exact large rust-orange layered flower ornament at the side of her head, dark hanging ribbons and fine ivory lace veil, exact ivory dress with copper-orange botanical embroidery, lace shoulder cape/collar and modest fitted bodice. Do not substitute another Claude design, change hair hue, change age, add armor, or turn her into a generic nun. Produce ONE coherent character design sheet on a plain warm light-grey studio background: a dominant full-length three-quarter/front standing view from flower to shoes, and two smaller supporting views at right: the same character from behind, and a detailed portrait/head-veil view. Same person, same garment and hair length across views, realistic anime proportions matching the input, not chibi. Infer only the unseen lower skirt and back conservatively: a full-length ivory layered fabric skirt with restrained matching rust botanical embroidery and simple closed ivory shoes, veil continuing from the existing flower. Lower-skirt/back details are proposed extensions, not new ornate redesigns. Hands relaxed at sides. Convey quiet vulnerability without crying or violence. Detailed Japanese illustration with softly painted volume, delicate lace and hair detail, restrained warm copper highlights, consistent with the reference. All of figure and veil contained with comfortable margins. No labels, no text of any kind, no prompt panel, no palette swatches, no watermark, no surrounding black-robed people.
